purpose: The two games and their roles in the recipe. 'primary' = the game Melty installs into and starts; 'companion' = read from the player's own copy (Melty passes its folder).

folder_delivery.about: How the mod learns the L4D2 folder: an env var of the mod's own, set in the recipe from {game:left-4-dead-2} (or a file mapping). Confirm with validate_recipe.

toolchain.about: Target framework, Unity version and BepInEx 5 build to compile against.

tested_build.about: Build id or version of each installed game this sheet set was checked against.

game_info_findings.about: What game_info says: account risk (if any), what stopped other mashups, how a mod reads camera, key bindings and players.

rows.name: Risk of Rain 2
rows.what_it_brings: The game the player is in: stages, enemies, items, loadout screen and skill system. The mod's code runs inside it.
rows.toolchain: net472 with BepInEx 5 and HarmonyX, Unity 2019-era Mono (candidate)

rows.name: Left 4 Dead 2
rows.loader: none (files are only read, never changed)
rows.what_it_brings: Coach's real model, animations and voice lines; the real guns and throwables and their sounds. All read from the player's own install at runtime. Nothing from L4D2 ships in the upload.
